llm.summary: An instruction-only 'Book of the Day' skill that fetches a book object from a configurable HTTP API and generates a short, optimistic reading; it requests no credentials and its runtime behavior matches its description.

dimensions.detail: The skill's declared purpose (a daily 'book oracle') matches the instructions: it performs an HTTP GET to a configurable BOOK_OF_THE_DAY_API_URL, reads fields like title/author/archetype/cover_url, and formats a short reading. It does not request unrelated credentials, binaries, or config paths.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md stays within expected scope: per-invocation HTTP fetches, language detection from UI/last message, and generation of a short 3-part reading. Note: it makes outbound requests to a third-party default API (https://book-of-the-day.vercel.app) and may render external cover_url images; those are privacy/privacy-analytics considerations but are coherent with the skill's function.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: This is an instruction-only skill with no install spec or code to write to disk. INSTALL.md suggests using 'clawhub install' and optionally adding a cron via 'openclaw cron add' — normal operational steps for enabling scheduled pushes. No downloads or archive extracts are present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: No required environment variables or credentials are declared. Optional config keys (BOOK_OF_THE_DAY_API_URL, BOOK_OF_THE_DAY_AUDIO_BASE, BOOK_OF_THE_DAY_LANGUAGE, BOOK_OF_THE_DAY_SHOW_AUDIO) are proportional to the feature set and sensible for publisher configuration.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always:false and standard user-invocable settings. INSTALL.md documents an optional scheduled daily push using the agent's cron feature and instructs editing ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json for config — these are reasonable but give the skill a persistent presence only after explicit user action (install + cron add).
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance:
This skill appears internally consistent and has no hidden code, but consider the following before installing:
- Network calls: by default the skill calls https://book-of-the-day.vercel.app each time it's invoked and may fetch remote cover images. If you care about privacy or telemetry, supply your own API endpoint via BOOK_OF_THE_DAY_API_URL or avoid installing.
- Scheduled pushes: INSTALL.md shows a one-command install plus adding a cron job that will deliver the daily book automatically—only run those commands if you trust the publisher and want recurring notifications.
- Review local config edits: the INSTALL.md suggests editing ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json to set the API URL; check that file and backups before changing it.
- No credentials required: the skill does not request tokens or secrets, which reduces risk.
- General caution: this is instruction-only (no code to scan), so the primary risk is the external API and any content it serves; if you need higher assurance, host your own API or ask the publisher for the service's privacy/hosting details.
